reviews.title: Great quality fans
reviews.comment: Really good fans. They keep my computer temps at 80 max with just these and one other unbranded fan.
reviews.author: Bradley

reviews.title: NZXT releases another great product!
reviews.comment: Great fan with a more subtle rgb lighting effect than core fans.
reviews.author: Tim M.

reviews.title: Top tier case fan!
reviews.comment: If you’re wondering if they’re worth the money, YES. These fans are fantastic and virtually silent. I bought one initially as a rear exhaust fan in my new build and ended up buying the 240mm one as well. Right out of the box you can feel the build quality, as they’re fairly heavy for case fans. A testament to the high quality materials used.
reviews.author: Stephen C.

reviews.title: Price point could be a bit better
reviews.comment: I was very surprised after installing this into my pc, it has the main roll in my system as the lower case fans for an intake. I’d love to also purchase another for my aio cooler that’s top mounted as an exhaust. My only issue is the price point and the fact that the fans are a bit noisy. Other than that this product is definitely worth it.
reviews.author: MrJayBird

reviews.title: PERFORMANCEE
reviews.comment: The F240X performance fan on the NZXT kraken AIO 2024 the F240X plugs and plays into the AIOS Breakout cable this fan is phenomenal airflow is outstanding it lowered my AIO liquid temps by 2-3 it blows air through the radiator like crazy the performance fans are serious
